title: Solving Trigonometric Equations
standard_text: P.5M generate and solve trigonometric equations in mathematical and real-world problems
meta_desc: Free Precalculus worksheets on trigonometric equations for Texas TEKS P.5M: basic and linear equations, factoring, multiple angles, general solutions and models. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Find the reference angle, then every quadrant with the right sign.
key_sub: Factor; never divide by a trig function.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Get the trig function alone, then find the reference angle.
  • Use the signs in each quadrant to find every angle in 0 ≤ x < 2π (usually two).
  • For sin2 x − sin x = 0, factor: sin x(sin x − 1) = 0. Do not divide by sin x.
  • All solutions: add 2πk (πk for tangent). For sin 2x, solve for 2x first, then divide.

Examples

Example

2 cos x + 1 = 0, 0 ≤ x < 2π

cos x = −12

Reference angle π/3, Quadrants II and III

Answer: x = 2π3, 4π3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Only one solutionLook in both quadrants with the right sign.
Dividing by sin xFactor instead, or you lose sin x = 0.
Forgetting + 2πkAll solutions repeat every period.
